_title: The EMC systems map — a machine-checkable registry of routes, objects, evidence, instruments, artifacts and claims
_role: NAVIGATION AND INTEGRITY LAYER. It records WHERE each fact lives and checks that the pointer resolves. It grades nothing, re-derives nothing and restates no figure that has a home elsewhere (CLAUDE.md §1 — one fact, one place).
_owner: research/manuscripts/emc-systems-map.json is the ONE HOME of this registry. research/manuscripts/emc-systems-map.md is DERIVED from it and is regenerated, never hand-edited.
_cost: $0 — no GPU, no rental, no purchase, no contact, no wet lab.
_why_it_exists: One piece of evidence carried under two names. ⛔ SUPERSEDED ATTRIBUTION, RETAINED so it stays quotable and searchable: five repo files cited the NOR-1 druggability result under a wrong author name (a misattribution), always without a PMID, for the paper other places cite correctly as Zaienne et al., ChemMedChem 2022, PMID 35704774. A route was graded while its own supporting evidence sat in another file, unfindable under a name that matches no paper. ✅ The misattribution was measured, corrected and retired on 2026-08-03 — one home in `research/modalities/nr4a3-druggability-reconciliation.md` §5b, pinned by `research/modalities/tests/test_munck_attribution_retired.py`. THIS REGISTRY'S JOB IS THE STRUCTURAL HALF: every name a source travels under resolves to ONE evidence item, so the class of error cannot recur under a new name.

One object carried under two incompatible definitions: 'the canonical EMC fusion' names a modelled EWSR1 e7 :: NR4A3 e3 construct that is NOT a reported fusion type, and the reported type 2 protein carries 59 extra UTR-encoded residues that fusion_cofold.py's protein-level model does not have.
One grade applied to two different routes: the covalent probe at C397 and a monovalent reversible pocket modulator fail on OPPOSITE blockers and must never share a row or a demotion.

A number quoted from an artifact that is a STUB on the branch a reader would open: emc-fet-idr-census.json is a 161-byte 'cannot compute' placeholder on `main` while emc-post-degrader-options.md on `main` prints a full results table out of it.
_limits: This registry asserts NO grade, NO tier and NO number of its own. Every grade cell names the file that owns it; every claim names the artifact field that owns it.
It makes no efficacy, potency, safety, therapeutic-window or clinical-readiness claim for any route or molecule, and none follows from anything in it.
It is not complete over the whole repo. Its scope is the EMC treatment-route portfolio plus the objects, evidence, instruments and artifacts those routes rest on.
Where the record genuinely conflicts and the registry cannot resolve it from what is committed, the conflict is logged in `open_conflicts` rather than decided.

identity.what_this_cannot_settle: Cell-line identity is settled by STR authentication against the donor and by RT-PCR for the fusion. What IS established is that the PUBLIC RECORD does not support the label this repository was applying.

_closure_model._why: trimcrae, 2026-08-03: AI methods are advancing fast, so many currently-closed paths WILL be unblocked — and a register that files a permanent fact about a sequence alongside a limitation of today's free-energy engine loses exactly the information needed to know which is which. `closure_kind` is therefore an ENUMERATED field, not prose.
_closure_model._source_of_the_categories: The repo's own §6a/§6b register already reasons in these words (Definitional · Arithmetic · Premise false · Confound in the system · Unregenerable artifact), and §6b already requires each parked row to NAME what has to land. This registry makes those machine-readable and checks them; it invents no category and re-grades nothing.

definitional.meaning: a fact about what the objects ARE — e.g. a residue the paralogues SHARE cannot discriminate between them, or a ligand whose mechanism lives in a domain the disease deletes. NEVER revivable.

arithmetic_over_fixed_fact.meaning: an arithmetic consequence of a fixed measured fact — e.g. the zinc-finger DBD's paralogue identity against the LBD's. NEVER revivable.

premise_false.meaning: a stated premise was measured and is not true. Revivable only if the measurement or the underlying fact changes.

confound_in_the_system.meaning: the TEST SYSTEM cannot answer it. Revivable by a DIFFERENT test system, not by a better method and not by more sampling.

unregenerable_artifact.meaning: ⚠ THE TWO HALVES THIS REPO HAS CONFLATED: the specific RESULT is unrecoverable forever, and the QUESTION it was asked of is OPEN. The trigger is what re-answers the question, never what recovers the result.

instrument_limit.meaning: ⭐ THE METHOD CANNOT RESOLVE IT TODAY — the most revivable category and the one most of this program's failures actually fall into. Filing these beside a definitional impossibility is precisely the information loss this field exists to prevent.

authorization.meaning: waiting on a person, not on nature.

cost.meaning: waiting on a budget, not on nature.

_closure_model._derived_never_typed: `permanently_closed` and `revival_would_reopen` are DERIVED (from `closure_kind` and from the trigger registry respectively) and are regenerated into the view, never written into this file. The checker FAILS if either is typed here — CLAUDE.md §1: a derived value is regenerated, not hand-maintained.
_closure_model._specificity_rule: A `revival_trigger` string must be usable verbatim as a literature-search query — a sibling agent's weekly field scan searches for them by name. So it must NAME a method, benchmark, artifact, measurable quantity or capability, and must not lean on a bare comparative ('better X', 'improved X'). Enforced by the checker's Z4.

revival_triggers.trigger: a free-energy method (FEP or ML free-energy) validated on cryptic / induced-fit pockets — an ABFE or RBFE engine that reproduces a public known-answer benchmark to within 1 kcal/mol on a pocket absent from the apo structure
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The program's ABFE engine under-binds T4-lysozyme L99A/benzene by more than the entire selectivity margin it is used to compute, and the FEP tier the degrader needs is least reliable on exactly the cryptic, induced-fit pocket this target presents.
revival_triggers.watch_list_evidence: free-energy (FEP or ML free-energy)** on **cryptic / induced-fit** pockets

revival_triggers.trigger: an atom mapper that reaches the 20-atom provable floor on the 19th congeneric edge WITHOUT a degenerate correspondence — i.e. without mapping a carbon onto a hydrogen
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The best available map reaches 19 and the search budget is provably not binding (identical maps at t20 and t300), so more search time buys nothing; the one map that does reach 20 gets there by a chemically impossible correspondence.

revival_triggers.trigger: a validated charge-change correction for alchemical free-energy edges — a co-alchemical-ion or PME finite-size treatment demonstrated to reproduce a known-answer set of charge-changing transformations
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Charge-changing edges block legs of the step-1 fan-out and killed the high-contrast calibrator route. ⚠ The correction reopens the EDGES, not the P-series DESIGN, which stays a poor calibrator on perturbation size alone.

revival_triggers.trigger: an OBSERVED rather than COMPOSED CRL RING / E2~Ub geometry — a deposited cryo-EM or crystallographic full-assembly structure that replaces a composed model carrying tens of angstroms of positional uncertainty
revival_triggers.why_this_string: No degradation-geometry claim may rest on a RING or E2 that was composed rather than observed, and the E3-choice selectivity readout is not stable under restaging — both are statements about the geometry's provenance, which only an observed assembly changes.

revival_triggers.trigger: an interface-stability readout with power at achievable sampling, OR a different test system whose interface effect is large enough for the E1 endpoint to resolve
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Two independent attempts returned no pass, the second on an adequately powered design — so the block is the readout's resolution against this system's effect size, not the sample size. ⚠ Two failures is strong evidence, not proof of impossibility.

revival_triggers.trigger: a ternary alchemical free-energy method that PASSES the valB known-answer cooperativity control — recovering the reference ΔΔG_coop with the correct sign, not merely with more sampling of the present protocol
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The closure triangle localises the present miss to an ENDPOINT-STATE error, which is a property of the model or the reference data; more sampling of the same endpoints cannot fix it.

revival_triggers.trigger: a validated prospective molecular-glue design method or glue-interface selectivity predictor, demonstrated on a CRBN or DCAF neosubstrate interface that was not in its training set
revival_triggers.why_this_string: A glue has no linker, so it has no covalent axis and no designed exit vector — the modality most likely to arrive from someone else's screen rather than from this program's design, which is why it is a watch trigger rather than a build item.

revival_triggers.trigger: a deposited partner-free liganded structure for one of the blocked E3 recruiters (RNF114, DCAF16, DCAF15) — a handle pocket rather than a glue interface
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Availability was the wrong constraint; structural stageability binds. RNF114 has no deposited structure at all and DCAF16's ligand is largely buried once its partner is removed.

revival_triggers.trigger: access to a patient-derived EMC model (NCC-EMC1-C1, USZ-EMC, or an authenticated H-EMC-SS) through a collaborator or a solo-affordable cloud/robotic wet-lab service with EMC-runnable scope
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The cell-line repositories exclude individuals by published policy rather than by price, so every confirm-gated EMC row is gated on a collaborator and no budget reaches it. This trigger is about ACCESS, and it is the single highest-fan-out non-method trigger in the portfolio.

revival_triggers.trigger: an oligonucleotide tumour-delivery technology reaching non-hepatic solid tumours — an AOC/conjugate, tumour-penetrating peptide or ligand-targeted LNP platform — OR a characterised EMC-enriched surface antigen to serve as its targeting arm
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Delivery is the ASO route's one remaining gate and it is engineering rather than biology, so it is watched two ways: a delivery PREDICTOR to score a candidate in silico, and a delivery TECHNOLOGY to be that candidate.

revival_triggers.trigger: generative equilibrium-ensemble models (BioEmu, AlphaFlow, subsampled-MSA AlphaFold) validated against known cryptic pockets — recovering CryptoSite/PocketMiner benchmark sites without GPU-days of metadynamics
revival_triggers.why_this_string: It collapses the per-target 'open the pocket' cost from GPU-days to pennies, which is what decides whether the cryptic-pocket druggability atlas is a focused target class or proteome-scale. ⚠ Its (a) arm already fired 2026-07-24; the calibration half has not.

revival_triggers.trigger: a solvent-exposure or thiol-reactivity criterion that recovers NR4A1 C551 as engageable on a state-matched opened model — i.e. an exposure instrument that passes the one NR4A-family covalent positive control with literature support
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The standing EXPOSED_RSA cutoff fails that positive control, so anything it adjudicates inherits a demonstrated false negative and only a threshold-free rank survives. A criterion that passes it makes the covalent screen readable again rather than rank-only.

revival_triggers.trigger: an anti-target docking protocol in which every panel receptor recovers its own cognate crystallographic ligand inside the pre-registered 2.0 Angstrom criterion, with no receptor dropped, no box re-centred and no band lowered
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Three of ten receptors miss, so `panel_readable` is false and all four SI scope clauses that are maximum-over-the-panel statements are unreadable. A failing target may not be dropped, which is what makes this a protocol trigger rather than a curation one.

revival_triggers.trigger: a pose-prediction protocol whose site transfer places the crystallographic ligand inside its own box in regime, and on which two scoring-independent methods converge in ORIENTATION as well as location on the same receptors
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Two independent transfer routes both put the site at zero in regime, and two disjoint scoring functions disagree in orientation at a median far above their centroid separation — so the non-convergence is the system's, and a single better docker is not the trigger.

revival_triggers.trigger: a primary report of NR4A3/NOR-1 forming a permissive or ligand-modulable heterodimer with RXR in cells, contradicting the published negative that NOR-1 is unable to promote RXR signaling
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The whole closure turns on one measured biological fact about this receptor, so only a contradicting primary measurement of that same fact reopens it — no method advance does.

revival_triggers.trigger: a paralogue-selectivity positive control whose selectivity is reproduced by a NON-covalent readout — i.e. not attributable to a covalent bond at a residue the off-target paralogues lack. A different test system, not more sampling of NR-V04
revival_triggers.why_this_string: NR-V04's geometry readout passes for the wrong reason, and no sample size and no better method fixes a confound in the system. Only a different control compound or a different system does.

revival_triggers.trigger: a re-run of the ternary generation from a logged, bond-order-complete ligand definition — the QUESTION re-answered on a recorded input, never a recovery of the unrecoverable original result
revival_triggers.why_this_string: ⚠ THE DISTINCTION THIS REPO HAS CONFLATED. The specific artifact can never be replicated by anyone, us included, because the molecule folded is unrecoverable; the question it was asked of is open and is answerable on a properly logged input.

revival_triggers.trigger: the TCIP-configuration linker enumeration executed — the same paired anchor-plus-effector-recruiter reach calculation already built for the E3-free configuration, run with a transcriptional-effector second terminus
revival_triggers.why_this_string: A TCIP is still bivalent, so the monovalent result does not transfer; the machinery exists and takes one more anchor set, which makes this the cheapest promotion available in the options memo.

revival_triggers.trigger: fusion-breakpoint-neoantigens.json regenerated against the corrected exon index, so that every predicted peptide-HLA binder spans a seam that a reported junction actually produces
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The predicted binders currently span seams that do not exist, which is a defect of the input index rather than of the prediction method — so the trigger is a regeneration, and it is free.

revival_triggers.trigger: a fetchable public EMC RNA-seq or proteomics dataset deposited beyond the single DepMap model ACH-001519, enabling an NR4A3-target regulon-dominance readout and a per-antigen expression confirm on real EMC tissue
revival_triggers.why_this_string: EMC is nearly absent from public functional-genomics data and the one line is n = 1 with no CRISPR data — the repo-wide rate-limiter. It is a DATA trigger, not a method one, and it fans out across every route whose in-silico half is bounded by n = 1.

revival_triggers.trigger: trimcrae authorizing the CREBBP versus BRD4(1) / SGC-CBP30 selectivity ABFE — the program's only binary selectivity control and its highest-leverage unrun item
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Nothing failed and nothing is missing; it is built and staged with no result key. This is an authorization, not a capability — it could run tomorrow.

revival_triggers.trigger: a VECTOR delivering a transcriptional or nuclease payload to a non-hepatic solid tumour — AAV, lentiviral, or a non-viral vector platform with demonstrated solid-tumour biodistribution
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Split from TR-OLIGO-TUMOUR-DELIVERY on 2026-08-06 by the route framing audit. The registry carries BLK-DELIVERY and BLK-VECTOR-DELIVERY as SEPARATE blockers precisely because the evidence clearing one need not clear the other, and taxonomy/blockers.md states the consequence: merging them would let one arriving imply the other had. Three vector-gated routes were pointed at the OLIGONUCLEOTIDE trigger, so an AOC or LNP platform landing would have read as reopening them. research/method-watch-triggers.json recorded this divergence and deferred it to 'whoever owns the registry'; this is that decision.

revival_triggers.trigger: a primary report DEMONSTRATING the direction of effect of 6-mercaptopurine (or any AF-1 agonist) on the EWSR1::NR4A3 FUSION rather than on wild-type NR4A3 — i.e. a measurement RESOLVING whether it suppresses or ENHANCES fusion transcriptional output, or one CONTRADICTING the gain-of-function prior on which this closure now rests
revival_triggers.why_this_string: ⛔ MINTED 2026-08-06 by the route framing audit. RT-6MP was filed `definitional` — permanently closed, no trigger — on the premise that the fusion DELETES NR4A3's AF-1. That premise is measured FALSE: NR4A3 transcript exons 1-2 are non-coding, so the chimera retains AF-1, DBD, hinge and LBD in all 9 DBD-retaining breakpoint windows. What survives as a closure ground is DIRECTION OF EFFECT — 6-MP enhances NR4A3 while the fusion is a gain-of-function oncoprotein — and that rests on a prior, not a demonstration (no direct loss-of-function experiment in any EMC cell line exists). A closure resting on a prior is `premise_false`, and premise_false must name what would change it.

revival_triggers.trigger: a fusion-junction epitope PREDICTED to be presented on more than one common HLA allele, or a class-II arm regenerated from patient-cd4-demo.json at the corrected seam that demonstrably raises combined CD8∧CD4 population coverage above the 27.4% pooled figure measured on 2026-08-07
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The 2026-08-07 regeneration repaired the input and made the route WORSE: the corrected e7::e3 public junction is presented on HLA-B*15:01 ALONE, so class-I coverage is 8.51% and the pooled panel 27.4%. The route is therefore no longer closed on a defective artifact — it is closed on COVERAGE, and only a coverage change reopens it. Naming 'a stronger epitope' would be the wrong string: the epitopes are real, they reach too few patients.

revival_triggers.trigger: patient-cd4-demo.json regenerated at the corrected junction seam, so that hla_coverage.py can report a class-II arm whose provenance matches its class-I arm and coverage_cd8_and_cd4_combined becomes quotable
revival_triggers.why_this_string: INS-HLA-COVERAGE's two arms now have DIFFERENT provenance: class I is recomputed from the regenerated panel, class II still comes from a demo built on the retracted seam. The module measures the mismatch itself and emits ⛔_class_ii_provenance, so coverage_cd4_classii and coverage_cd8_and_cd4_combined are not quotable until this fires.

revival_triggers.trigger: INS-FUSION-COFOLD's protein-level model regenerated on the TRANSCRIPT model — the EWSR1 cut plus the 2 nt of retained NR4A3 5'UTR — replacing EWS_CUT = 264 and 'NR4A3 resumed at res 2', and demonstrated to reproduce the corrected seam that fusion_breakpoints.py now predicts
revival_triggers.why_this_string: Its defect is the same CDS/transcript slip the neoantigen panel just had corrected, so the seam regeneration did NOT repair it — the instrument builds its own model. Pointing it at the satisfied seam trigger would have marked it revivable when nothing about it had changed.

revival_triggers.trigger: a residue-resolution phase-behaviour model, or a second independent force field such as Mpipi, that resolves a difference between EMC 5' fusion partners smaller than 0.06 in the Flory scaling exponent nu -- or any published wet-lab measurement of EMC condensate behaviour (droplet formation, FRAP recovery, or saturation concentration) reported STRATIFIED BY 5' fusion partner rather than pooled across them
revival_triggers.why_this_string: The CALVADOS single-chain arm ran to its prespecified standard and returned a bounded null: 55 runs, no partner window separated from any other, and its directional control moved, so the instrument was working. What it could NOT do is resolve differences under about 0.06 in nu, which is why the trigger names a resolution rather than a repeat. ⛔ A re-run of the same arm with more sampling is NOT this trigger -- the arm's own prespecification forbids extending it after seeing the numbers.

_scan_interop._why: A sibling agent's `research/method-watch-triggers.json` (schema method-watch-triggers/1) is THE ONE HOME OF THE SEARCH QUERIES that detect each trigger, and it explicitly defers the route<->trigger graph to this registry. Its `_open_reconciliation` recorded the cross-check as one-directional and unenforced because this registry had no `revival_trigger` field yet. This field closes that from this side.
_scan_interop._the_split: That file answers HOW to look for a capability. This registry answers WHAT a hit would reopen. Neither restates the other, and a trigger of ours that has no `TRG-*` counterpart is a capability nobody is scanning for -- which the checker reports rather than hides.

_kinds.external_capability: a method or tool someone else must publish or release -- scannable
_kinds.external_measurement: a primary measurement contradicting a fact we rely on -- scannable
_kinds.external_data: a dataset someone else must deposit -- scannable
_kinds.external_access: access to material or a service; not a paper, so a literature scan detects it only indirectly
_kinds.internal_work: a computation or regeneration THIS programme can run. Nothing external needs to land, so there is nothing to scan for -- and a trigger of this kind sitting unfired is a backlog item, not a wait
_kinds.authorization: waiting on trimcrae, not on nature
